reason: E1 supports the entropy-stabilization premise for bulk HEAs but does not address nanoparticles or the full temperature range. E2 supports entropy stabilization in oxides, not metallic nanoparticles. E3 demonstrates solvothermal synthesis of HEA nanoparticles but provides no evidence on structural/chemical stability under the specified service conditions. The key premises about nanoparticle stability across 473–1923 K are therefore largely unsupported by the cited evidence.
premises: High configurational entropy stabilizes solid-solution phases in HEAs
